usage.source_scope: 宽视野扫描发现稳定文字候选，再递归云台居中/变焦；报告了文字识别增益。
usage.project_application: 已落入 core:assist 的目标控制器：按证据缺口选择 SWEEP/SCAN/PAN/APPROACH/SIDESTEP/HOLD，且只有新鲜语义可锁定、导航和重捕获。
usage.modifications: 把机器人云台动作改为人持手机的相机相对提示；外观连续性最多保留两帧补观测权限，不能取得身份。LOST 后需两次新鲜语义命中，身份或终点证据丢失会撤销 HANDOFF_READY。
usage.expected_effect: 消除 OCR 非命中导致的错误 STOP/假 NONE，为每个不可导航帧产生有界且可解释的补观测动作，同时阻止连续性证据越权。

evaluation.setup: ArTVideo video1+video10 Development replay, 30 injected-gap episodes; SC1W identity/continuity was frozen and SC2 only normalized non-exhaustive absence plus mapped evidence deficits to camera-relative actions. The same policy is now implemented in core:assist.
evaluation.effect: Terminal STOP frames fell from 124 to 0, target-present false-NONE frames from 24 to 0, every non-navigation frame received an explicit action, and all 30 episodes retained end-to-end acquisition plus reacquisition.
evaluation.claim_boundary: Development replay representation and runtime contract evidence only. The replay did not execute camera or body actions, so it does not establish causal readability gain, natural-distribution performance, metric arrival, product benefit, user benefit, or safety.

evidence.summary: Legacy source for l10:9; imported without changing its recorded evidence boundary.
